finsights.brief: Trading at a low earnings multiple

summary: Agricultural Bank of China reported H1 net profit up 5.8% YoY and operating income up 11.2%, with return on net assets at 10.14%.
Net interest margin improved 2 bps to 1.28% from Q1; NPL ratio fell 2 bps to 1.25%, marking fifth consecutive quarterly decline.
Board proposed raising interim dividend payout ratio to 31% from 30%; shares traded flat at $6.23, down 0.32% post-announcement.
Management expects net interest margin to stabilize as deposit repricing continues; plans to add 2,000 rural service points in 2026.
Bank targets maintaining county-level business at 40% of total operations while expanding AI-driven services and inclusive finance offerings.
